book.name: Matoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Matoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yuhuda Kaqeteth
Maalado wonttara qeeseta halaqatinne dere cimati wurikka Yesusa wodhana oge zorettida.
Yesusa qachchi efidi dere haariza Philaxoosas aaththi immida.

Iza aaththi immida Yuhudaykka Yesusa bolla pirdettidayssa be7idi, «Ta iza aaththa immontta aggarkina» giidi ba ekkida heedzdzu tammu biraa qeeseta halaqatassinne dere cimatas zaari immidi, «Xillo as aaththa immida gishshas ta mooradis» gides. Isttika, «Histtiin nuus ay metoo! Ne era ekka!» gida.
Hessa gishshas Yuhuday biraa efidi Xoossa Keeththa giddon yeggidi kezi biidi cuuletti hayqqides.
Qeeseta halaqati biraa denththidi, «Suuththa waaga gidida gishshas Xoossa Keeththa miishshan gujjanaas bessenna» gida.
Ba giddon zorettidi imath gidida asatas duufo gidana mala issi urqqa miish medhdhiza hiillaza gade shammida.
Hessa gishshas he gadey hach gakkanaas suuththa gade geetettees.

Izas waaga gidana mala, «Isra7eele nayti heregida heedzdzu tammu bira qoodi ekkida. Xoossi tana azazida mala urqqa medhdhiza hiillaza gades immida» geetettidi nabe Ermaasa doonan yootettidayssi polettides.
Philaxoosa Sinth Yesusa Shiiqo
He wode Yesusi dere haarizayssa sinth shiiqides. Dere haarizayssika, «Neni Ayhuda kawoo?» giidi iza oychchides. Yesusikka, «Ne gida mala gido» gides.
Qeeseta halaqatinne dere cimati iza mootishin Yesusi isttas aynne zaaribeenna.
He wode Philaxoosi Yesusa, «Aappun yo7on nena mootizaakko siyikkii?» gides.
Dere haarizayssi keehi malalettana gakkanaas Yesusi issi qaalakka zaaribeenna.
Dere haarizayssas ba7aale gallas derey qasho asaappe, «Ebeloy nuus birshetto!» gi oychchiko issaade birshiza wogay dees.
He wode gene ooson erettida Barbaane geetettiza issaadey qashoson dees.
Derey shiiqida mala Philaxoosi, «Barbaaneppenne Kirstoosa geetettiza Yesusappe ta inttes oona birshana mala koyeetii?» gides.
Philaxoosi istta coo qanaates aaththi immidayssa erishe oychchides.
Izi pirda alga bolla utti dishin iza machcheya, «Iza gaason hach tani agumora daro metotadis; hessa xillo addeza bolla ne aykkoka ooththontta mala» giza kiita Philaxoosas yeddadus.
Gido attiin qeeseta halaqatinne cimati isttas Barbaaney birshettana malanne qasse Yesusa wodhana mala woossanaas dereza qaalay gaaggana mala ooththida.
Dere haarizayssi, «Nam7atappe oona birshana mala koyeetii?» gi oychchiin istti, «Barbaane birsha!» gida.
Philaxoosikka, «Histtiko Kirstoosa geetettiza Yesusa wosttoo?» gides. Intte wurikka, «Kaqetto!» gida.
Philaxoosikka aazas? «Izi ay iita ooththidee?» giidi istta oychchides. Isttika qasse keehi waassidi, «Kaqetto!» gida.

Philaxoosi hanizayssi wurikka asay ba giddon bul7aketeththafe attiin hara ay go7ay bayndayssa yuushshi xeellidi, «Hayssa addeza suuththaa gomeppe ta geeshsha; hayssafe guye intte shene» giidi haath ehisidi dereza sinththan ba kushe meecettides.
Derey wuri, «Iza suuththi nu bollanne nu nayta bolla gakko» giidi zaarides.
He wode Barbaane isttas birshidi Yesusa garafissidaappe guye kaqqana mala aaththi immides.
Yesusa Bolla Wottadarata Qilcca
Hessafe wottadarati Yesusa gede dere haarizayssa gibbe ekki biidi wuri shiiqidi Yesusa giddo aaththida.
Iza may7o qaaridi hara zo7o may7o mayzida.
Agunththa akilile xaaxidi giigsida; iza hu7e bolla woththida; shomboqo guufe ushachcha kushen oyththidinne iza sinththan gulbatidi, «Ayhuda kawoo! Inttes too!» giidi iza qidhida.
Iza bolla cuttida; shomboqo guufeza iza kusheppe ekkidi Yesusa hu7en zaari zaaridi shocida.
Iza bolla qidhi kaa7idaappe guye qasseka zo7o may7oza qaari ekkidinne kase iza may7oza zaari mayzidi kaqqanaaso ekki bida.
Yesusa Kaqeteth
Istti ekki bishin Qareena geetettizasoppe yida Simoona geetettizayssa demmidi masqaleza iza wolqqara toossida.
Birsheththay, «Hu7e guugge» geetettiza Golgota gakkishin ciyera walakettida woyne cajje, «Uya» giidi immida; gido attiin izi ganxi ekkidi uyana koyibeenna.
Iza kaqqidaappe guye iza may7oza bolla saama yeggidi gishettida.
Heen uttidi iza naagida.
«Hayssi Ayhuda kawo Yesusa» giza mooto qaala iza hu7eppe bollara woththida.
Nam7u pangatappe issoy Yesusappe ushachcha baggara, issoy hadirsa baggara izara issife kaqettida.

Ogera aadhdhi biza asay cayishenne hu7e qaaththishe, «Xoossa Keeththaa laallada heedzdzu gallassan zaara keexxana gizayssoo! Ane nena ashsha; ne Xoossa Naa gidikko ane masqaleza bollafe wodhdha» gida.
Qeeseta halaqati dere cimatara gididi iza bolla qidhishe;
«Hara asaa ashshides shin bana ashshanaas dandaybeenna; izi Isra7eele kawo gidikko ane ha7i masqale bollafe wodhdho; nunikka iza ammanana.
Xoossan ammanettides; bana Xoossa Naa gida mala Xoossi iza dosizaa gidikko ane ha7i iza ashsho» gida.
Izara issife kaqettida pangatikka hessaththo cashsha qaala iza bolla qoqofida.
Yesusa Hayqo
Gallas usuppun saateppe biidi uddufun saate gakkanaas kumeththa biittay dhumides.
Uddufun saate gidishin Yesusi qaalaa dhoqqu histtidi, «Eelohe! Eelohe! Lama sabaqitane» giidi waassides. Hessa guussas birsheththay, «Ta Xoossoo! Ta Xoossoo! Tana ays aggadii?» guussa.
Heen eqqida asaappe issi issi asati iza waasoza siyidi, «Eelaasa xeygees» gida.

Isttafe issaadey woxxi biidi zandza misatiza safinege geetettiza miish ekkidi caalida woyne cajjen yeggi caphisidinne shomboqo geetettiza miththa xeeran qaaphidi uyana mala Yesusa doonaakko shiishshides.
Hankko asay qasse, «Aggaagite ane, Eelaasi yiidi iza ashshishin beyana» gida.
Yesusi qasseka dhoqqa qaalan waassidi shempo kezides.
He wode Xoossa Keeththaa magalashay bolla hu7era duge simmi daakettidi nam7u kezides; biittay qaaxxides; zaallati za7ida.
Duufoti doyettida; kase hayqqida Xoossa asaappe dariza baggay dendides.
Duufoppe kezidi Yesusa denththaafe guye geeshsha katama gelidi darota ayfen beettida.
Mato halaqaynne izara issife Yesusa naagizayti biitta qaaththaanne hanidayssa ubbaa be7idi daro babbida. Qasse, «Hayssi tumappe Xoossa Naakko!» gida.
Galilappe yiidi Yesusa koshshizaazan ooththi maaddanaas kaalliza daro maccassati hanizayssa wursika haahora xeellishe heen deettes.
Istta giddon Magdaleppe yida Maaramiranne, Yaaqoobenne Yooseefe aayo Maaramira, qasseka Zabdoosa nayta aayeyra issife deettes.
Yesusa Moogeteth
Gadey omarsishin Yooseefe geetettiza issi dure adde dayssi Armatiyase geetettizasoppe yides. Izikka ba baggara Yesusa kaallizaade.
Izi Philaxoosa sinththi shiiqidi Yesusa aha izas immana mala woossiin Philaxoosikka izas immana mala azazides.
Yooseefey ahaa ekkidi geesh gidida moogo afalan xaaxides.
Shuch woocidi baas giigsida duufon efi woththidi gita shuch genderisi duufoza gordides.
He wode Magdale Maaramiranne hankko Maaramira duufoza ginan uttida.
Sambatas giigettiza wonteththa gallas qeeseta halaqatinne Farsaaweti Philaxoosa sinth shiiqidi,
«Godoo! He wordoy kase paxa dishe, ‹Heedzdzu gallassafe guye ta dendana› gida qaalay nu wozinan turchchu gides.

Hessa gishshas iza kaallizayti iza ahaa kaysoti ekkidi deraas, ‹Izi hayqoppe dendides› giidi woresontta mala heedzdzanththo gallas gakkanaas duufoy naagettana mala azaza; akkay giikko kaseyssafe guye balay aadheth gidana» gida.
Philaxoosi, «Inttes naagizayti deettes; biidinne inttes erettida mala naagisite» gides.
Isttika biidi duufoza doona maatamen gordidi naagana zabe essida.
